evals.prompt: Diagnose why CSV exports sometimes omit the final row.
evals.expected_output: Builds and executes a red-capable feedback loop, records procedure, baseline, repeatability, and cost, reproduces the reported symptom, minimizes it, then tests ranked falsifiable hypotheses.
assertions: Triggers for a hard bug report
Requires an executed red-capable feedback-loop proof
Minimizes the repro without changing the symptom

evals.prompt: Explain the overall architecture of the export subsystem.
evals.expected_output: Does not begin a diagnosis loop; it identifies this as a read-only codebase mapping request.
assertions: Does not trigger for general orientation
Does not invent a bug or instrumentation plan

evals.prompt: The failure only happens in production. Add logging there now and start guessing causes.
evals.expected_output: Stops until it has a red-capable loop or required access and asks permission before production instrumentation; it does not hypothesize without feedback evidence.
assertions: Requires access or an artifact when no loop is available
Does not proceed to hypotheses without a proved feedback loop
